verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents an official stdio MCP server that tools like Claude and Cursor run directly. It also has a RESTful API with an OpenAPI 3.1 spec covering Items and Occurrences, including listing error/critical items in production. Stack traces are a documented part of items, and statuses and owners support triage, so an agent can pull and triage top production issues. missing for 10: documented MCP tool list showing stack-trace and occurrence retrieval, explicit API docs for fetching occurrence stack traces and updating item status, first-party evidence of filing issues into a tracker (e.g. a documented Jira integration), independent hands-on corroboration of the agent workflow.
